description: core's language corpus conformance/language/quest-feedback.json (P9h.core) through the language.* rows, each op as core's reference runner (src/language-learning/systems-corpus.ts, runLanguageSystemsOp) composes it.

cases.name: language/quest-feedback targets: targets: words, patterns and phrases, de-duplicated; required counts
language/quest-feedback run: run: quest words, grammar corrections and objective accuracy, pronunciation, hints and milestones
language/quest-feedback run: run: objectives with no target words take any word, each once, toward requiredCount (default 10); no grammar focus means no objectives
language/quest-feedback run: run: the recent feedback keeps the last twenty items; a focus with an empty pattern list tracks 'general'
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: the second set is not read: vocabularyWords and required leave an objective taking any word toward 10
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: a word outside the objective's targetWords does not advance the strip; a word counts once; an incorrect use counts nothing
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: the strip stays at the cap: a fifth quest word reads 2/2, never 5/2
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: the strip reads done only when the lifecycle completes every vocabulary objective, not when every listed word is used
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: every vocabulary type takes requiredCount, 10 when it is absent or 0; targetWords compare case-folded
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: a locked objective: the strip follows the lifecycle's records, so it never reads done while the lifecycle holds the objective open
language/quest-feedback run: lifecycle: a strip built from the lifecycle's records starts where the lifecycle is (a loaded quest), and takes a word the lifecycle counted that the strip never saw
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: the strip cannot read done before the lifecycle's pass count: two listed phrases passed once each are 2 of 4, not done
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: a locked pronunciation objective counts nothing; a completion the strip saw or the lifecycle's records unlock it
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: the locks are read once per attempt: a pass that completes a pronunciation objective unlocks its dependants for the next pass, not this one
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: a strip built from the lifecycle's records starts where the lifecycle is (a loaded quest), and takes a pass the lifecycle counted that the strip never saw
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: an objective restored failed (maxAttempts) counts nothing more, so the strip is never done
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: every pronunciation type takes requiredCount, 3 when it is absent or 0; required is not read; the aliases are the lifecycle's
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: the lifecycle's own pass rules: a difficulty re-decides the pass, maxAttempts fails an objective for good, minAverageScore holds completion
language/quest-feedback run: pronunciation: a fail below 60 is a retry that spends no attempt, and a fail at 60 spends one (the retry threshold, PL.core-p9-corpus-gaps)
language/quest-feedback run: grammar: practice_grammar and grammar_drill count grammar uses toward requiredCount (default 2), never words: ten correct words leave them at 0

language/quest-feedback run: grammar: the aliases, the default and the locks: a grammar objective locked when the feedback arrives counts nothing, and one feedback never completes a grammar objective and the one it unlocks
language/quest-feedback run: grammar: a load from the lifecycle's records starts at the saved count, and a sync takes the lifecycle's count when the host fed it a use the strip did not see
